inline_text: Adds one entry to the presentation queue for 1 October, following the chairs' invitation on the 3 September call. The session maps a live implementation onto the Agent Identity Primitives draft, lists where it does not fit, and proposes Vector as a shared, open environment where the group can deploy and test its primitives with real but bounded consequences. 30 minutes preferred; a shorter slot works.
